properties.name: app.storage.enabled
properties.description: Enables S3-compatible media storage and media API services.

properties.name: app.storage.public-endpoint
properties.description: Browser-reachable S3-compatible endpoint embedded in signed media URLs.

properties.name: app.storage.region
properties.description: S3-compatible bucket region used to sign media URLs without contacting the public endpoint.

properties.name: app.storage.max-product-images
properties.description: Maximum number of active images stored for one menu product.

properties.name: app.security.refresh-cookie-name
properties.description: Host-only HttpOnly cookie name used for rotating browser refresh tokens.

properties.name: app.security.refresh-cookie-secure
properties.description: Adds the Secure flag to the refresh cookie; this must be true in shared and production HTTPS environments.

properties.name: app.dashboard.worker.minimum-events
properties.description: Pending event count that triggers dashboard projection before the maximum wait expires.

properties.name: app.dashboard.worker.maximum-wait-ms
properties.description: Maximum age of the oldest dashboard event before a projection run starts.

properties.name: app.dashboard.worker.trigger-check-ms
properties.description: Interval for the lightweight pending-dashboard-event threshold check.

properties.name: app.dashboard.worker.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of dashboard events processed in one transaction.

properties.name: app.dashboard.worker.max-batches-per-run
properties.description: Maximum bounded batches drained after one dashboard worker trigger.

properties.name: app.logging.http.include-bodies
properties.description: Includes bounded, recursively redacted JSON request and response bodies in HTTP completion logs.

properties.name: app.logging.http.max-body-bytes
properties.description: Maximum JSON body bytes considered for one sanitized HTTP request or response log field.
